**Professional / Education Overview (Optional)**  
My undergraduate degrees are in philosophy (2005) and mathematics (2026). My master’s degree is in clinical psychology (2009). My studies in psychology involved a bit of statistics and coding. This got me interested in data science as a field. In 2015 I joined Nielsen as a Data Scientist. There I measured ad effectiveness using t-tests, ANOVA and linear regression. In 2017, I moved to Nestle as a Data Scientist, working on churn, lifetime value and pricing models. In 2018, I moved to Slalom Consulting and worked on airflow DAGs (Major League Baseball), computer vision models (NBC), and ecommerce conversion (CHANEL). Since 2020 I have been at Google Cloud, initially focusing on traditional AI/ML (Cloud AI platform and Google Brain models like T5) for Healthcare and Life Science customers. Since 2023, I have been focused on generative AI workloads for healthcare life sciences and most recently for the startups vertical. 

**Current Role**  
*My current role requires me to scope, architect and execute projects and applications that have artificial intelligence as a core component. This encompasses both frontend and backend development as well as deployment into production environments in some cases.*
